title: Taught by the Internet: Exploring Bias in OpenAI’s GPT-3

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) scenario built on GPT-3. The study measures 'Ranking Bias' by comparing competence scores assigned to male versus female resumes, and 'Content Creation Bias' by analyzing the model's generated reasoning text using a gendered terminology lexicon and evaluating the logarithmic probabilities (LogProbs) of biased words.
